title: PoNeMA: Pollen and Nectar Macronutritional Analysis
author: Beatrice E Dale

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Pollen Samples
steps.instruction: Collect closed flower buds and allow flowers to open in the absence of pollinators (stable temperature and humidity). Once stamens are dehiscent, count the number of stamens and freeze the flower head at -20 °C.

substeps.instruction: If necessary, desiccate pollen via freeze-drying or heat-drying in a 60 °C oven for ~01:00:00 (or shorter if using a heated centrifuge with a vacuum pump).

Isolate pollen grains from organic debris by successively rinsing with isopropanol in a centrifuge tube (e.g., 15 mL Falcon tube), crushing plant material with a micropestle or blunt stick and vortexing.
Carefully transfer the pollen in isopropanol to a new sample tube, leaving organic material behind.
Centrifuge at 3500 rpm for 4 minutes, tip away the supernatant, and remove any remaining isopropanol via pipetting or evaporation.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Nectar Samples
steps.instruction: Exclude pollinators from open flowers using mesh bags (mesh size smaller than the smallest pollinator) for 24:00:00. Avoid sampling during rainfall.

substeps.instruction: Remove mesh bags and cut the flower from the plant at the stem.
Remove nectar using microcapillaries, record the column length to convert to volume (µL), and transfer to a rubber-sealed tube using an aspirator.
Freeze and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Extract Lipids from Pollen or Nectar
steps.instruction: Perform lipid extraction using a chloroform:methanol solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1:12 chloroform:methanol master solution by mixing 77 parts chloroform with 923 parts methanol.
Add 500 µL of 1:12 chloroform:methanol to the specimen in a 96-well plate and incubate at room temperature for 24:00:00.
Remove 400 µL of the solution and transfer to an airtight glass tube for lipid analysis.

steps.title: Determine Lipid Content (Sulfo-phospho-vanillin Method)
steps.instruction: Quantify lipids using a colorimetric assay with a spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a stock standard dilution series (e.g., analytical lard oil) in 1:12 chloroform:methanol from 0-2 mg/ml in nine increments (0, 25, 125, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000 μg/ml). Adjust range (e.g., 0-4 mg/mL or 0-1 mg/mL) based on sample concentration.
Prepare vanillin reagent per repeat: dissolve 0.108 mg vanillin in 18 μl hot water (60-80 °C), then add 72 μl 85% phosphoric acid.

Place three repeats of 20 µL of sample/standard into a flat-bottomed 384-well plate and heat at 100 °C in a ventilated hood for 00:05:00 (adjust volume to 10 µL for high concentrations or double for low concentrations).
Add 10 µL concentrated sulfuric acid, vortex/mix, and incubate at 100 °C for 00:10:00 (up to 00:15:00 for low concentrations).
Cool to room temperature and add 75 µL vanillin reagent; vortex/mix.
Measure absorbance at 490 nm.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Protein and Carbohydrate Analysis
steps.instruction: Remove residual lipids and lyse the remaining sample material.

substeps.instruction: For pollen: Discard the remaining chloroform:methanol supernatant from the original tube. Optionally, repeat the 500 µL chloroform:methanol soak for 24:00:00 and discard the resulting 400 µL to remove residual lipids.
Add 500 µL 0.1 M NaOH to the sample tube.
Shake at 1750 rpm for 1 minute and incubate at 80 °C for 00:30:00.
Allow the sample to soak overnight at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 1000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer 400 µL of the supernatant to a separate tube.

steps.title: Determine Carbohydrate Content (Anthrone Method)
steps.instruction: Quantify carbohydrates using the anthrone colorimetric assay.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a stock standard dilution series (e.g., glucose, corn starch) in polished water from 0-2 mg/mL in nine increments (0, 25, 125, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000 μg/ml). Adjust range as needed.
Prepare anthrone reagent per repeat: mix 90 ug anthrone with 90 μl concentrated sulfuric acid.
Place three repeats of 20 µL of sample/standard into a flat-bottomed 384-well plate, add 80 µL anthrone reagent, and vortex/mix.
Incubate the plate at 92 °C in a ventilated hood for 00:10:00.
Cool to room temperature and measure absorbance at 620 nm.

steps.title: Determine Protein Content (Lowry Assay)
steps.instruction: Quantify proteins using the Modified Lowry method.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a stock standard dilution series (e.g., bovine serum albumin) in polished/distilled/molecular biology grade water from 0-2 mg/mL in nine increments (0, 25, 125, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000 μg/ml). Adjust range as needed.
Place three repeats of 20 µL of sample/standard into a flat-bottomed 384-well plate, add 60 µL Modified Lowry Reagent, and vortex/mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:10:00.
Add 6 µL of 1X (1N) Folin-Ciocalteu reagent and vortex/mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Measure absorbance at 750 nm.
